summary: Implemented the S3 Expires change without running tests or repo code. Changes: (1) botocore/parsers.py: in BaseRestParser._parse_non_payload_attrs, a header member that is a timestamp shape named Expires is parsed inside try/except; on failure the member is omitted and LOG.warning is emitted. (2) botocore/utils.py: new customize_expires_shapes(service_data) adds a string shape ExpiresString and a header member ExpiresString (locationName Expires) to every operation output shape containing Expires, and prepends a deprecation note to the Expires member docs; idempotent. (3) botocore/client.py (_load_service_model) and botocore/session.py (get_service_data) call the helper. (4) Added .changes/next-release/enhancement-S3-expires.json. Choices: tolerance is keyed on the shape name/type, which only affects S3 (Kinesis Video's Expires is an integer); the cached model dict is mutated in place. Not verified: no tests were run; recommend running S3 unit and functional tests and checking malformed Expires header behavior. Nothing was committed.
